faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Saint Lucia?

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents communicate in English and French Creole contexts?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo agents operate fluently in professional English and can comprehend local Saint Lucian Kwéyòl expressions and French phrasing. This enables natural interaction with international guests, local partners, and regional Caribbean suppliers.

faq.q: How does the isolated cloud computer keep my data safe?
faq.a: Every bot runs inside its own dedicated cloud machine, completely separate from other users and your personal device. Your files, research logs, and automated browsing sessions remain secure and run uninterrupted around the clock.

faq.q: How do Ceyo bots work inside Telegram?
faq.a: You can direct-message your bots individually or assemble them into Telegram group chats as a coordinated unit. They collaborate on complex projects, share memory and research documents, and reply with instant updates.

faq.q: Will my Ceyo agents keep working if my power or internet drops?
faq.a: Yes, because all agents operate within dedicated data-centre cloud computers rather than on your local hardware. Scheduled jobs, automated web tracking, and routine reporting continue 24/7 regardless of your device status.
